node.title: Component-defect localization at the strict endpoint
node.statement: At the first strict A=3 endpoint, let E be overlap among the distinct irreducible-component incidence sets, D_i=T r_i-I_i the row deficit, C_i=N e_i-I_i the column deficit, and b the total parameter degree outside the unique defect-one component. The generator is geometrically squarefree and the exact ledgers are sum D_i=O-E and sum C_i=1+O-E. The dominant component satisfies C_*-D_*=4b+1, while every balanced residual component satisfies D_i-C_i=4e_i. Hence 4b<=O-E and e_*>=m-floor((O-E)/4). Every component splits disjointly on at least 3m+2 supported slopes and at least 15m domain fibers; at least 3m+1-O supported slopes are also parameter-transverse. The dominant nonlinear component remains open.
